summary.story: Vanishing Point (Chinese: 消失的人) is a 2026 Chinese crime thriller film written and directed by Cheng Wei-hao, produced by Veronica Jin, and starring Zheng Kai, Liu Haocun, Roy Chiu, Li Chen, and Jiang Yan. The film was released in China on May 1, 2026.
